scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Former Sports Person of UP
other_conditions: The applicant must be a domicile of Uttar Pradesh
The applicant must be an old, weak, or hardship‑facing former sportsperson
Monthly income from all sources must not exceed ₹10,000
benefits_summary: Provides monthly financial assistance ranging from ₹2,000 to ₹20,000 depending on the sportsperson’s level and awards
